src/LandingPage.Api/Api.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi" Version="8.0.4" />
    <PackageReference Include="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore" Version="6.5.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="Serilog.AspNetCore" Version="8.0.1" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
.github/workflows/build.yml:
name: Build and Package

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  DOTNET_VERSION: '8.0.x'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Test
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Publish
        run: dotnet publish src/LandingPage.Api/Api.csproj --configuration Release --output ./publish

      - name: Create Octopus Package
        uses: OctopusDeploy/create-zip-package-action@v3
        with:
          package_id: 'Acme.LandingPage.Api'
          version: '1.0.${{ github.run_number }}'
          output_folder: ./packages
          base_path: ./publish
          files: '**/*'

      - name: Push to Octopus
        uses: OctopusDeploy/push-package-action@v3
        with:
          server: ${{ vars.OCTOPUS_SERVER_URL }}
          api_key: ${{ secrets.OCTOPUS_API_KEY }}
          space: 'Acme'
          packages: './packages/Acme.LandingPage.Api.1.0.${{ github.run_number }}.zip'

      - name: Create Octopus Release
        uses: OctopusDeploy/create-release-action@v3
        with:
          server: ${{ vars.OCTOPUS_SERVER_URL }}
          api_key: ${{ secrets.OCTOPUS_API_KEY }}
          space: 'Acme'
          project: 'Landing Page API'
          release_number: '1.0.${{ github.run_number }}'
          git_ref: ${{ github.sha }}
